_comment: Food banks removed from the map at their own request. Every pin whose id is the slug or starts with slug/, or whose website host matches, is dropped on every refresh (scripts/build.py), so discovery/Give Food can never re-add it. Entries with "exact": true drop only the pin whose id equals the slug (its own centre pins slug/... stay).

foodbanks.name: Oldham Foodbank
foodbanks.reason: Referral-only delivery service; asked not to be listed (Dean, 22 Oct 2026)

foodbanks.name: Felix Multibank
foodbanks.reason: Supply hub: community organisations collect non-food items; does not serve the public (https://thefelixproject.org/felixs-multibank). Removed 22 Oct 2026 per Dean

foodbanks.name: Oxford Food Hub
foodbanks.reason: Surplus redistribution to charities only; 'not able to supply food directly to individuals' (https://oxfordfoodhub.org/getting-food/individuals/). Removed 22 Oct 2026 per Dean

foodbanks.name: Bradford Metropolitan Foodbank
foodbanks.reason: 'do not distribute food directly to those in need' - supplies registered third-party organisations only (https://bradfordfoodbank.com/). Removed 22 Oct 2026 per Dean

foodbanks.name: Lincoln Foodbank (Beaumont Manor offices)
foodbanks.reason: Beaumont Manor LN1 1UL is Acts Trust's offices, Community Grocery and cafe, not a foodbank centre (Foodbank Team email, 22 Oct 2026). Their centre pins lincoln/... stay. Per Dean

foodbanks.name: Lincoln Foodbank - St Hugh's Church, North Hykeham (LN6 8JB)
foodbanks.reason: No longer a foodbank centre (Lincoln Foodbank / Acts Trust Foodbank Team email, 22 Oct 2026 16:27). Per Dean

foodbanks.name: Salvation Army Worcester (The Trinity, WR1 2PN)
foodbanks.reason: Not Worcester Foodbank (likely a donation point or community fridge); reported via map form by Worcester Foodbank coordinator, 23 Oct 2026. Real Worcester Foodbank (id worcester, 7 Lowesmoor Wharf, WR1 2RS) stays.

foodbanks.name: United Reform Church, Horsham (duplicate)
foodbanks.reason: Duplicate of horsham-district/united-reform-church (same postcode RH12 2RG, same phone 0300 124 0204, 60 m apart); kept the entry with opening times. Merge approved by Dean, 24 Oct 2026.
